q1.explanationZh: 通知说有人捡到了蓝色运动包，丢包的学生带身份卡去学校办公室领取。A 错：出示身份卡只是证明包是自己的；C 错：包已经找到了，只是失主还没来领。

q2.explanationZh: 3.1 室在维修，Gray 老师的学生到周五前改在 4.2 室上课，所以她暂时不能用原来的教室。A、B 错：通知没说她不来学校，课也没改到别的日子，变的只是地点。

q3.explanationZh: 下周学校厨房不供应热午餐（closed for hot lunches），但仍提供三明治和沙拉，所以只有少数几种食物。A、B 错：学校仍会供应部分食物。

q4.explanationZh: Mark 问 Suzy 今天晚些时候要不要把做完的历史作业拿去给她看。B 错：作业已经完成；C 错：是 Mark 自己明天要交给老师。

q5.explanationZh: Ben 告诉 Tom 网上还有余票，如果认识想去的人可以告诉他们。A 错：Ben 已经说了还有票（There are some tickets left）；C 错：爸爸已经会来接他们（pick us up）。

q6.explanationZh: 一些成员想学用软件修图，Jones 老师提出如果人数够，下周二就开始教。B 错：没人说要退出俱乐部；C 错：想了解软件的是成员，不是 Jones 老师。

q7.explanationZh: Kojo 说书很棒，只是最后几页（the last few pages）的情节不真实，即不喜欢结尾。A 错：Jian 也提到结尾，但他读完后遗憾没有更多内容，说明他喜欢。

evidence.quote: I still think it’s great, except the last few pages. What happens in them doesn’t seem real.

q8.explanationZh: Max 说小时候还不识字时，父母给他读故事，他很喜欢看书里的图画（loved looking at the drawings），用过去时说明那是以前的事。

evidence.quote: Even before I could read, I loved looking at the drawings as my parents read the story to me.

q9.explanationZh: Jian 说明了书的来历：在邻居送的一箱旧书里（in a box of old books that a neighbour gave me）。B 错：Max 只说书现在归妹妹；C 错：Kojo 只说朋友也读过。

evidence.quote: This well-known book was in a box of old books that a neighbour gave me.

q10.explanationZh: Kojo 喜欢这本书，因为它讲的是在他完全不了解的地方长大的人的故事。A 错：Jian 只介绍了两个朋友玩游戏的情节，没说他们的生活与自己不同。

evidence.quote: it was about people growing up in a place which I knew nothing about

q11.explanationZh: Jian 讲了故事内容：两个朋友玩一个游戏，以及游戏如何改变了他们的生活。B 错：Max 谈的是作者，而不是情节。

evidence.quote: It’s about two friends who play a game, and how it changes their lives.

q12.explanationZh: Max 说没多少人听说过这本书（not many people have heard of it），即它不太有名。A 错：Jian 的书正相反，是 well-known。

evidence.quote: not many people have heard of it

q13.explanationZh: Jian 读到最后一页时很难过，因为没有更多内容可读了（was quite upset that there wasn’t more）。C 错：Kojo 是不喜欢结尾，不是因读完而伤心。

evidence.quote: when I got to the last page, I was quite upset that there wasn’t more

q14.explanationZh: 工人告诉 Pat 哪里做得不对，帮助她慢慢做好，也就是她听从了建议。B 错：妈妈教她的是做酸奶；C 错：她第一次自己做的奶酪并不好。

evidence.quote: the workers told me what I was doing wrong and that helped me to slowly get better

q15.explanationZh: 牛奶来自父母农场的奶牛，Pat 需要时向父母要就行（them 指她的父母）。A 错：邻居给的小牛还不能产奶。

evidence.quote: Pat can just ask them when she needs more.

q16.explanationZh: Pat 说获奖帮助顾客了解了她家的奶酪，即更多人知道了。B 错：没说她会出现在广告里；C 错：只是在新西兰卖奶酪，没有被邀请去。

evidence.quote: It’s been great for helping customers find out about us

q17.explanationZh: Pat 说目前更重要的是搞好学业（doing well in my studies）。A 错：她只是想在网上发食谱，不是写书；C 错：她只是希望将来有餐馆买她的奶酪。

evidence.quote: doing well in my studies matters more for now

q18.explanationZh: 主旨题：全文依次讲 Pat 如何学做奶酪、牛奶从哪里来、获奖以及未来计划，说明她如何参与到家里的奶酪生意中。A 错：没讲家里为什么开始做奶酪；B 错：获奖只在第三段提到。

q19.explanationZh: spent a lot of time learning about it 表示“花大量时间学习它”，只有 learning 能和后面的 about 搭配；studying、understanding 都不能接 about。

evidence.quote: spent a lot of time

q20.explanationZh: 给年轻工程师的全国性“竞赛”用 competition。match 是分队进行的体育比赛，game 指游戏或体育活动，都不合适。

evidence.quote: for young engineers when he was just 13

q21.explanationZh: started his own business 意为“开办了自己的企业”。became 和 turned 放在这里语意不通。

evidence.quote: his own business

q22.explanationZh: 只有 way 能和后面的 of 搭配：a way of doing（……的方法）。plan 和 thing 都不能这样用。

evidence.quote: of sending pictures using electricity

q23.explanationZh: 另一家公司为他的点子出价 100 万美元，用 offered（提供，出价）。sold 不对，卖点子的是 Farnsworth；took 也不合语意。

evidence.quote: him $1 million for his idea

q24.explanationZh: these days 是固定短语，意为“如今”；times 和 years 都不能和 these 搭配表示“如今”。

evidence.quote: He is not very famous these

q25.explanationZh: biggest 是最高级，前面要用 the：the + 形容词最高级 + 名词。

evidence.quote: biggest country I’ve ever been to

q26.explanationZh: by + 交通工具表示出行方式，如 by train、by bus，这里是 by car。

evidence.quote: We travelled from Los Angeles to Seattle

q27.explanationZh: 固定短语 a very long time（很长一段时间），冠词 a 不能少。

evidence.quote: very long time – nearly a week

q28.explanationZh: 家人最喜欢洛杉矶，而“我”不同意，前后是转折关系，可填 but、(al)though 或 however。

evidence.quote: My family liked Los Angeles best

q29.explanationZh: 比较级 smaller 后接 than：西雅图比洛杉矶小。

evidence.quote: It’s smaller

q30.explanationZh: 说天气要用代词 it 作主语：it rained almost every day（几乎每天都下雨）。

evidence.quote: rained almost every day

q31.sampleAnswer:
Dear Lee,
As you know, me and my family are going camping next weekend, but as we are such good friends, I have decided that you can be our guest. My mother said I need to expirience the outdoors a bit more.
You have got to bring your own equitment, since we don’t have any extra. Don’t forget your flashlight, sleeping bag, and an extra coat!
I hope you can come,
your friend

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：邀请 Lee 和你及家人一起去露营；说明去露营的原因；告诉 Lee 要带什么
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
Dear Lee,
As you know, me and my family are going camping next weekend, but as we are such good friends, I have decided that you can be our guest. My mother said I need to expirience the outdoors a bit more.
You have got to bring your own equitment, since we don’t have any extra. Don’t forget your flashlight, sleeping bag, and an extra coat!
I hope you can come,
your friend
anchors.noteZh: 三个内容要点都清楚表达；使用多种连接词和衔接手段（but, as, since），行文连贯；虽有小的拼写错误，但主题词汇使用恰当（guest, the outdoors, flashlight, sleeping bag），熟练运用多种简单语法结构。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response:
Hi Lee,
Do you want to come with me and my family, because we will go to a camping? If you want to come please bring some sandwiches.
Text me soon
Love, Viktor
anchors.noteZh: 没有写清去露营的原因，但涵盖了其他要点；衔接合理，但只用了 and 和 because 两个连接词；能熟练运用简单语法结构，词汇丰富性只达到基础水平。内容3/条理性3/语言3。

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要写清三点：邀请 Lee 一起去露营、说明为什么去露营、告诉 Lee 要带什么，并用连接词把句子连贯地连起来。

q32.sampleAnswer: One day Sam and Zac were hanging out and walking on the road and they saw 20£. They were so happy. They grabbed the 20 pounds and ran to the icecream shop. They ordered two large vanilla icecreams. They ate their icecream and continued with their day.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：两个男孩在路上发现地上的钱；捡起钱；用钱去冰激凌店买冰激凌
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: One day Sam and Zac were hanging out and walking on the road and they saw 20£. They were so happy. They grabbed the 20 pounds and ran to the icecream shop. They ordered two large vanilla icecreams. They ate their icecream and continued with their day.
anchors.noteZh: 涵盖三个内容要点且表述清晰；连接词运用很基础，但有效衔接了故事各部分；恰当使用日常词汇（hanging out, icecream shop [应为 ice-cream shop], vanilla），能正确运用简单语法结构。内容5/条理性4/语言5。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要写出三幅图的内容：两个男孩在路上看到地上的钱、捡起钱、用这笔钱去店里买冰激凌，并用连接词把情节连贯地串起来。
